title: Sponsor a cat
intro: Can't adopt right now? You can still help. Every cat here needs food, vaccines, flea treatment and vet care, and some need diapers too. Tap a cat to see what they need and sponsor it.
bills_intro: Some of our costs are shared by all the cats. You can cover one of them, all of it or part of it.
